==Description==
The '''Mini Commander Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the default Level 4 [[Commander]] skin. Anybody who bought the toy from the in-game Merch Store will receive the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} skin for the [[Commander]]. If bought on the [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games store], it will not come with any rewards.

The walkie talkie has a glow in dark screen. It is made out of plush fabric, Polypropylene cotton and felt. It is 10.6 inches wide, 10.2 inches tall and 6.3 inches deep, or 26.924 centimetres wide, 25.908 centimetres tall and 16.002 centimetres deep. A tree is planted for every order of the '''Mini Commander Plush'''.

==Official Description==
*'''Online (Second)'''
*:Lead the charge with the Commander Mini Plush. Trained for precision and strategy, this powerhouse keeps your squad in formation at all times. This plush does not include an in-game reward. 
*'''Online (First)'''
*:Lead the charge with the Commander Mini Plush. Trained for precision and strategy, this powerhouse keeps your squad in formation at all times. The in-game reward is only included with purchases made in Roblox. Items purchased from shop.paradoxum.games do not include an in-game reward.

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Mini Commander Plush''' could be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] or the in-game Merch Shop for $26.99.
